response: {"texts":[{"id":"DMSR-6957","text":"The DMS shall construct on an as-needed basis an image that corrects for any temporally stable bias structure that remains after overscan correction."},{"id":"DMSR-1633","text":"The DMS shall produce on an as-needed basis a dark current correction image, which is constructed from multiple, closed-shutter exposures of appropriate duration."},{"id":"DMSR-7466","text":"The DMS shall produce on an as-needed basis an image that corrects for the color-dependent, pixel-to-pixel non-uniformity in the detector response."},{"id":"DMSR-4608","text":"The DMS shall produce on an as-needed basis an image that corrects for detector fringing."}]}
